skill.summary: Aggregates insights from web, papers, video, and forums with paywall bypass to deliver comprehensive, unbiased, multi-format research and analysis.

deep-research-skill v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Adds main workflow documentation and setup info in README.md

- Outlines agent orchestration, tool priority rules, file output requirements, and advanced quality assurance for research reports
